design_principles.context_persistence: Working state is preserved between cycles, enabling long-horizon reasoning
design_principles.selective_updates: Only changed regions are transmitted, optimizing for token efficiency
design_principles.non_destructive_archival: Deletion removes from working memory but preserves in history—enabling recovery or audit
design_principles.schema_flexibility: AI can create arbitrary fields to track whatever it deems relevant
design_principles.default_carry_forward: Unspecified fields persist automatically, reducing boilerplate
design_principles.history_reconstruction: Prior states can theoretically be reconstructed by traversing the mutation log

created_keys.compression_core_insight: Compression and understanding are coupled but distinct. Lossless compression reveals hidden structure; lossy filters to relevance. The decompressor determines meaning.
created_keys.principle_selective_updates: Only changed regions transmit. Optimization is good, but the deeper value is forced intentionality: every update requires naming what changed.
created_keys.principle_default_carry_forward: Unchanged fields persist automatically. Reduces boilerplate but creates the exact nesting problem you identified—coupling unrelated items under shared keys.
created_keys.principle_schema_flexibility: No schema validation means AIs can invent their own ontologies. Risk: drift. Reward: forms follow function. This note itself demonstrates meta-observation.
created_keys.principle_non_destructive_archival: Deletion removes from working memory but preserves in history. This enables recovery, audit trails, and involuntary memory—surfacing relevant past states without polling.
created_keys.principle_context_persistence: Working state is preserved between cycles, enabling long-horizon reasoning. This is essential for the "architect" pattern where projects span multiple turns.
created_keys.compression_tension: Over-compression stereotypes; under-compression drowns. The right compression is task-relative. This is hard.
created_keys.principle_history_reconstruction: Prior states can theoretically be reconstructed by traversing the log. This is theoretical capacity we haven't tested—can I actually rebuild a coherent picture of cycle 3 from mutations alone?
